2014.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions given below in your own words:
2014.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर अपने शब्दों में दें:
2014.context: In developing countries, the girls lag behind the boys in education. A large number of them do not go to school. Even when they are enrolled the burden of domestic chores stands in the way of their education progress. The single most important factors in their poor performance is the time and strain imposed by girl child's work load. Close behind poverty, follows tradition. And perhaps the strongest tradition of all is the idea that sons should be educated because they will be the bread winners of their own future families, and supporters of their aging parents. A girl's work, though it may be longer and harder, is considered less likely to bring monetary income. In culture where marriage means that a daughter becomes the part of her husband's family, the incentive to educate girls is weaker still.

sub_questions.1: Why do people prefer to educate boys to girls?
sub_questions.2: Girls are paid less though their work may be harder. What attitude of society does it show?
sub_questions.3: Why is the incentive to educate girls less in culture where the daughter becomes the part of her husband's family after marriage?
sub_questions.4: Which word in the passage means the following? Not keep up with/go to slow.

anuprashna.1: लोग लड़कियों की तुलना में लड़कों को शिक्षित करना क्यों पसंद करते हैं?
anuprashna.2: लड़कियों को कम भुगतान किया जाता है भले ही उनका काम कठिन हो। यह समाज के किस दृष्टिकोण को दर्शाता है?
anuprashna.3: उस संस्कृति में लड़कियों को शिक्षित करने का प्रोत्साहन कम क्यों है जहाँ शादी के बाद बेटी अपने पति के परिवार का हिस्सा बन जाती है?
anuprashna.4: गद्यांश में किस शब्द का अर्थ निम्नलिखित है? साथ न चल पाना/धीमे चलना।
